visualReview.method: Inspected both actual Penpot exports: the1600×400 bar and the full review board.
findings: The dark wash is removed; frame, shared channel and Stop control use the light parchment treatment.
All eight tag names and monochrome glyphs are readable and use identical styling, with no active-tag fill.
Eight permanent precision sections are visible as matching ochre centre brackets below their corresponding tags.
The larger dark diamond and lower pointer have strong contrast, share the same horizontal position and remain clear of the tag glyphs and names.
Both cursor tips, precision marks, text and Stop control fit inside the bar without clipping. The review header and footer are also unobstructed.
visualReview.scope: Static visual refinement only; no Unity, gameplay or animation implementation.
